description: Department of Cooperative Development - Decided to Cancel the Registration of Cooperative Societies of Central Province Kandy District
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the cancellation of registration for multiple co-operative societies under provincial co-operative statutes. This falls under business/commercial matters as it deals with the administrative dissolution of business entities (co-operative societies), which is categorized under Commercial Gazettes (Type 6) for corporate dissolutions and commercial regulatory actions.
